description.value: La Fleur d'Oranger is a French-inspired artisan patisserie in North Vancouver specializing in handcrafted mousse cakes, cloud chiffon cream cakes, and 100% whole-fruit tarts made without extracts or shortcuts. The shop emphasizes meticulous technique — from hand-peeling citrus to slow-candying lemon peel over five hours — and offers a rotating seasonal menu. Cyclists stopping here will find a focused, high-quality dessert and pastry shop available for pickup order.
